name: Patrick S. Mensah
tagline: Power Platform developer and data professional building enterprise applications for public-sector teams.
bio: Certified Power Platform Developer who designs and deploys enterprise applications with Microsoft Power Platform, Dataverse, and integrated data solutions for New York State agencies. My work covers procurement, contracts, financial operations, and audit processes, built on a foundation in statistics, biostatistics, and data analytics.

skills: Power Apps: model-driven and canvas apps
JavaScript web resources and client-side form scripts
Dataverse security roles, business units, field security, and teams

photoAlt: Portrait of Patrick S. Mensah wearing a navy suit and light blue tie

education.institution: New Jersey Institute of Technology, NJ

experience.title: Data Analyst 2 / Power Platform Developer
experience.organization: New York State Office of Information Technology Services
highlights: Design, develop, and deploy enterprise applications with Model-Driven Apps, Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, and Power Pages, replacing legacy InfoPath and SharePoint-based solutions.
Design Dataverse data models, tables, relationships, business rules, calculated columns, and Business Process Flows for complex agency workflows.
Extend applications with custom pages, Power Fx components, JavaScript web resources, and client-side form scripts.
Build Power Automate cloud flows for approvals, notifications, document generation, and integrations across Microsoft 365.
Configure Dataverse security (business units, security roles, field security, teams) and design SharePoint permission models.
Take part in solution lifecycle management: packaging, environment deployment, version control, testing, and releases with Azure DevOps.

experience.title: AI Platform Engineer (Contract)
highlights: Served as technical advisor to the Director of Emerging Technology on Power Platform architecture, security, governance, and enterprise application implementation.
Designed Dataverse security architecture, including security roles, business units, teams, and access controls, with Microsoft Entra ID security groups for centralized access management.
Supported development of an AI platform using Code Apps and its readiness for production deployment.
Designed and supported ALM across Development, Test, and Production environments, including controlled promotion of solutions.
Provided guidance on governance, environment strategy, security, and deployment practices ahead of go-live.

experience.title: Data Analyst / Power Platform Developer
highlights: Architected and developed the Fiscal Contract Manager, a Model-Driven App on Dataverse that automates procurement, contract management, voucher processing, and financial tracking and replaces manual Excel-based processes.
Led the modernization of legacy SharePoint and InfoPath business applications with Power Platform solutions.
Led the replatforming of the Fiscal Revenue System from Oracle to Microsoft Power Platform.
Led the migration of the Division of Community Services SharePoint-based applications to Dataverse and Model-Driven Apps.
Built Power Automate flows for approvals, notifications, document management, and data synchronization across Dataverse, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365.
Automated statewide data collection and reporting with ArcGIS Survey123, XLSForms, Power Automate, SharePoint, and Power BI.
Partnered with Internal Audit on analytical solutions using Power Query, SQL, Python, and R for compliance reviews, fraud detection, and operational reporting.
Delivered training and user support on Power Platform, Power Query, and Microsoft 365 to increase adoption across business units.

experience.title: Area Manager
highlights: Managed technology-enabled operations in a high-volume distribution environment and used operational data and reports to find bottlenecks and performance gaps.
Supported testing and User Acceptance Testing for system and process changes, documenting results and confirming that solutions met operational needs.
Gathered requirements from frontline teams and management, and supported rollout, training, and documentation for new processes.
Led teams of 50 to 100 associates in a highly automated environment.
